text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r l-o-a-d-e-d the f-i-l-e-d c-l-a-i-m s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s into the m-e-m-o r-i-g-h-t s-i-d-e p-a-n-e-l and left a n-o-t-e b-o-o-k m-a-r-k-e-d "r-e-a-d-m-e" while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-y s-t-e-p
2) they t-a-g-g-e-d the h-a-t-e-f-u-l t-e-r-m-s as "b-i-o-d-i-v-e-r-s-i-t-y" in the s-e-a-r-c-h b-a-r and left a s-a-v-e-d f-i-l-t-e-r r-u-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w p-a-s-s
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-i-c-k-e-d the "o-u-t-l-i-n-e" b-u-t-t-o-n three t-i-m-e-s to c-r-e-a-t-e h-e-a-d-i-n-g s and left a w-o-r-d-c-o-u-n-t o-v-e-r-l-a-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-m-a-t c-h-e-c-k
4) they d-r-a-g-g-e-d the "p-r-o-s-e-c-u-t-e" f-i-l-t-e-r onto the "o-u-t-b-r-e-a-k" s-e-c-t-i-o-n and left a s-t-i-c-k-y n-o-t-e s-a-y-i-n-g "f-a-n-t-a-s-t-i-c" while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l
5) the a-c-t-o-r t-y-p-e-d the m-u-n-i-c-i-p-a-l-i-t-y n-a-m-e into the "a-d-d-r-e-s" f-i-e-l-d and left a c-o-p-y b-a-c-k u-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-i-r-m p-o-p-u-p
